title: Implement server authentication and release security controls

Min12 provider/gateway; fresh recovery proof or recent screened password proof and enrolled MFA AAL2 protect password updates

CSP admits only validated legitimate storage/media origins and preserves gallery/audio
Release rejects synthetic publication config and missing/stale/wrong/altered/forged exact-artifact evidence; dependency-maintenance evidence is executable

Fresh canonical PostgreSQL migrations, all-table policies/privileges, provider trigger/FK/retention/hooks and protected-API verification
